title: Moon Knight #4 Marvel 2006 Charlie Huston David Finch Cover Bushman
conditionDescription: Bright cover, light handling wear; small chip at the top right corner of the back cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Moon Knight #4 (September 2006), Marvel Comics - volume 5, The Bottom part 4. Charlie Huston story, David Finch cover and art, Danny Miki inks. Bushman on the throne over a fallen Moon Knight. Direct edition, Parental Advisory, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Who Wants to Be a Superhero? (Sci Fi Channel, Stan Lee) ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear; small chip at the top right corner of the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
